metadata.title: Banking Domain Data Analyst Interview Prep — the SQL Banks Actually Ask
metadata.description: The whole-book trailer: banking DA interviews add a regulatory/ratio/fraud-instinct layer on top of general SQL and Python. Two real worked examples carry the build-with-Claude loop — Ch.8's correct running-balance CTE (sum-before-filter) and Ch.9's cohort-preserving vintage-curve query (Harborline Card Co.) — bookended by the book's six-part map.
metadata.note: CLI-explainer video, required 12-beat spine (matches banking-domain-sql-running-total-bug's shape): B00 INTRO · B01 PROBLEM (Manim) · B02 MECHANISM (Manim) · B03 CLI/ASK · B04 CODE (Ch.8, correct) · B05 OUTPUT (Manim) · B06 CLI/CHANGE (required revision) · B07 CODE (Ch.9, cohort) · B08 OUTPUT (Manim) · B09 SUMMARY (Manim) · B10 NEXT STEPS (handoff) · B11 OUTRO. PM-driven branding change from the sibling reel: narrator says 'Hi, I'm Supriya' directly (no 'in for X' framing), and the visible on-screen handle in every composer/code beat's folderLabel and the OUTRO is 'Supriya' — not just spoken attribution.
metadata.v1_note: Replaces brutalist-art/reels/banking-domain-interview-end-to-end/ (a different, paid toolkit checkout — 7-beat Manim-only title-card montage, no composer/code beats). v1's 9:16 master was 2160x3840 but only 139.5kbps — underfilled frame, not a bitrate-cap issue. This v2 fixes fill via FILL-THE-CANVAS/TYPESIZE LAW + a new ClaudeCodeBeat916 component; bitrate follows from genuine content.
